summary: 200 OK · 20B markdown · stealthy · this call makes 1 extra direct request to the target before the browser runs: a liveness probe (direct, 3s, no retries, no synthetic headers, no redirect hop). Your service's own log will show that one next to the browser's navigation - it is dhole dialing, not the page. · pin=true could not be honored: an anonymous auto session is shared between callers and is recycled when idle, so there is no page of yours to keep open. Name a session_id= (the one you use for logins) and pass pin=true again. · the target is loopback/private, so the browser tier navigated without dhole's invented google referer. What that browser sends of its own (UA, `sec-ch-ua*`, `sec-fetch-*`) arrived as it always does, plus every header you named · 1 of 2 actions did not take effect (fill '#note': the selector matched no element (or none became actionable) before the timeout: Locator.fill: Timeout 10000ms exceeded.)
next_action: the step(s) listed as ok DID take effect on this page (read 'h1' as 'h'); the failed one never happened - retry just that action against a fresh copy of the page (metadata.actions lists one row per action). Re-running the whole chain replays the ok steps
